verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party help article titled "Calendar events and invitations", and community posts confirm a Fastmail calendar and calendar UI exist. That indicates the product handles events and invitations itself, but the pack contains only the article title, with no detail on seeing the calendar, replying to invites, or creating events from inside the mail view. missing for 10: documented in-client calendar view, documented invite-response (RSVP) flow, documented event creation from email, hands-on corroboration of integrated calendar workflow.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see my calendar, respond to invites, and create events without leaving the email client

citations.quote: Reporting a calendar UI bug took about 6 back-and-forths with first-line support
you can add your Fastmail calendar to Google Calendar
